definitions: A situation in which there is no real competition because one person or thing is clearly superior.
A plea in a legal case where the defendant does not admit guilt but also does not dispute the charges, leading to a conviction.
examples: When it comes to speed, the new car is no contest.
For sheer beauty, the Grand Canyon is no contest.
The defendant entered a plea of no contest.
With her experience, winning the election was no contest.
